name: Thrips
description: Tiny slender insects that feed by rasping plant tissue and sucking cell contents. They cause silvering, scarring, and distortion of leaves, flowers, and fruits, and some species transmit tospoviruses.
symptoms: Silver or bronze streaks on leaves
Tiny elongated insects visible with close inspection
treatments: Apply spinosad or abamectin at first signs of damage
Spray neem oil or insecticidal soap every 5-7 days
Use blue sticky traps for monitoring
Apply imidacloprid as soil drench for systemic control
Use predatory mites (Amblyseius cucumeris) for biological control
prevention: Remove weed hosts and crop debris
Use reflective mulches to repel thrips
Maintain crop diversity to support natural enemies
